answer: Proof-of-space binds each agent to a verifiable chunk of dedicated storage seeded by its identity. A verifier can ask for any random sector at any time, and only a real, isolated disk answers. Faking identities therefore means renting distinct volumes for every clone - cloud storage is billable and cannot be quietly shared. A saffron marker tagged each committed vertex, and the operator's quill of signed sectors proved the space was genuinely held, not emulated. Mass sybil farming becomes capital-heavy instead of nearly free.
